proposals.title: Append-only last-occurrence sufficient state for exact multiwindow DISTINCT
proposals.mechanism: At each monotone strict-past snapshot, v belongs to [a-w,a) iff last qualifying occurrence l(v)>=a-w. Share one typed map for windows; move membership between boundary intervals; use rank/prefix count structure. Keep one live expiry membership per value, not stale notices for raw occurrences. Raw count, observed recency and metadata remain separate.
proposals.testable_prediction: Repeated-value data reduces retained occurrence/expiry state relative to generic multiplicity and separate-window traces; nearly unique data or map/list overhead can remove or reverse benefit.
proposals.nearest_source_free_experiment: Compare direct sets, generic exact multiplicity+expiry and specialized latest map on <=4096 invented rows, repeated and all-unique controls, same-second duplicates, renewal before old expiry, NULL, peers/future suffix; reject deletion/time-travel contracts explicitly; count live state, moves, expiries and full sink.
proposals.benefit_task1: Automatically select exact sufficient state from operator and source contracts; make DISTINCT expiry cost and validity explicit without adding predictive information.
proposals.baseline: Correctness versus independent direct sets and generic multiplicity expiry; native phase only after separate authorization versus unchanged005 and A005-01 generic/specialized distinct, all with identical B/W output sink.
proposals.counterhypothesis: High distinct cardinality, pointer/hash overhead, ordering/preparation or final sink dominates; memory advantage vanishes on unique streams.
